question: In an election between two candidates, a candidate who gets 76 % of the total votes polled is elected by a majority of 1480 votes. What is the total number of votes polled? (Consider integral part only)
solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

The winning candidate gets 76% of total votes, meaning the losing candidate gets (100 − 76)% = 24% of the votes.

The difference in vote percentage = 76% − 24% = 52%.

This 52% difference corresponds to the winning majority of 1480 votes.

Total votes = (1480 ÷ 52) × 100 = 2846.15

Considering the integral part only, the total votes polled is 2846.

**∴ The correct answer is 2846 votes.**
